title: Generic Resource
description: Provides structured information about any type of resource (e.g., products, vehicles, electronics, real estate, jobs). Fully generic and editable for custom domains.

supportedIntents.description: Queries requesting specific products, categories, or inventory availability. Handles explicit items as well as feature-based searches (e.g., price ranges, specific years, subtypes).
example: Find SUVs from 2023 with a sunroof.

categories.description: High-level groups or classifications for the resource, e.g., 'Laptop', 'Car', 'Apartment'.

subtypes.description: Sub-categories or specific types within a category, e.g., 'Gaming Laptop', 'SUV', 'Studio Apartment'.

attributes.description: Attributes or properties of the resource that a user might query, e.g., 'price', 'color', 'size', 'year'.

minMaxRange.description: Numeric range filter for attributes, e.g., price, year, rating.

schema.description: Main query object defining the resource request.

type.description: Kind of request: 'list' to retrieve multiple resources or 'query' for filtered data.

filters.description: Filters to narrow down resources by category, subtype, name, year, or numeric ranges.

year.description: Numeric attribute such as year, release year, or custom field.
